name: Amazon

rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.tips: Practice speed and correctness on LeetCode Mediums. The work simulation section is extremely important — align your answers strictly with Customer Obsession and Bias for Action.

rounds.name: Technical Phone Screen
rounds.tips: Start coding only after clarifying constraints and walking through an example. Leave 10 minutes at the end for behavioral questions, and explain your thought process out loud.

rounds.name: Onsite Loop — Coding
tests: 1-2 DSA + LP behavioral questions per round
rounds.tips: Amazon onsite loops weave LPs into coding rounds. Expect questions like 'Tell me about a time you had to deliver under pressure' alongside your graph/tree questions.

rounds.name: Onsite Loop — System Design
rounds.tips: Focus on horizontal scaling, load balancing, and db sharding. Be ready to justify architectural decisions using trade-offs.

distinctives: Every round (even pure coding) allocates 15-20 minutes for Amazon's 16 Leadership Principles (LPs).
One interviewer is a designated 'Bar Raiser' who focuses entirely on cultural alignment and long-term potential.
Coding questions focus heavily on Trees, Graphs, Heap/Priority Queues, and Dynamic Programming.
levelsNote: SDE I (L4) · SDE II (L5) · SDE III (L6) · Principal (L7)
